column3: She can walk, swing, float in mid air, all between these ribbons, moving like water through the atmosphere.
The crowd gazes in silent awe as she moves against gravity and with the melody,
Gracefully rolling herself into an angel's sleeve, and descending to the Earth again.
It's undeniable-- nothing can match Ciel's grace and beauty!
In fact, some day, I'd like to get her in for an interview.
Ciel, tell us-- What's your number?
Sorry, listeners, but I'm not broadcasting the answer to that question.
Today I'd like to talk about Reborn's Fairy-type Gym Leader, Adrienn Flores.
Personally speaking, I've only gotten to know Adrienn very recently,
But I'd like to think that in our time working together around Reborn City, we've become pretty good friends.
Adrienn's that sort of person who knows how to sing xyr spirit into every syllable, and believe me, it shows.
In just the small amount of time xe's been around, xe's been able to attract more people to xyr life and xyr cause than anyone else I've ever met.
Hold up, that gives me an idea.
I've got a feeling that Adrienn would give some out-of-this-world dating advice.
Listeners, if you'd be interested in having Adrienn on the show for a segment, why don't you hit us up on Chatter and let us know what questions you'd have.
But back to the silver-haired silvertongue's day-to- day dealings, don't mistake xyr softness of heart for softness in battle.
Adrienn's battle style numbers in Doubles, and a Fairy pairing makes a very scary and fairly harrying team tearing into challengers left and right!
In particular, watch out for xyr Florges, Rhyannon-- a Pokémon that might as well run in xyr family.
With mixed moves to pack a pixie punch and more bulk than a beefed-up Blissey, it's gonna take a team effort to uproot this flower power.
But I gotta be honest with you guys-- I haven't had the best time lately.
Had a little accident--
And let's just say it's a miracle I'm fit to go on TV right now.
Eye patches are stylish, right?
I'll spare you all the details-- some of them are unclear to me anyway.
But for those who might be concerned-- no need.
What doesn't kill us makes us stronger, but probably needs to be pummeled into the ground anyway.
Enough about me-- we've got a Gym Leader profile to steal the show.
And who better to steal it than the Steel Leader herself, Titania Andersen.
Now Tania, as her friends call her, ain' the most friendly Leader on the chopping block.
She's got a personality harder than her element and a temper on the cutting edge.
But this smoldering beauty is forged of more than just a metal mettle and flare.
You'd never know from looking, but this lass has a literary lineage and the interest to match.
I'm told that above all other subjects in her education at the Onyx Trainers' School-- even battling-- Miss Titania chose to prioritize classic literature.
Who knows what about turning pages turns her head, but maybe it's this archaic aesthetic that draws her to older arts like drawing blades.
For a girl known to swing around her Aegislash as easily as if it were an épée,
It should be no surprise that the blade and buckle Pokémon also acts as her ace!
Those who intend to take arms against her should take care not to lose their own during the battle!
Today we'll be talking about an admirable allure in the astounding alacrity of the aqua artist, Amaria Fiore!
Amaria is Reborn's most senior Leader-- not in age, mind you, as this maritime maiden is as fair on the eyes as she is on the heart--
But despite her youth, she was the first Leader chosen by former Champion and Reborn League Manager Ame to take up a Gym Leader title.
Apparently, the two of them were somehow close friends and inspired each other to take steps to reopen the old League!
So for all those Trainers out there enjoying Reborn and its challenges, remember-- you've got Amaria Fiore to thank for it!
The lass has also made quite a splash in Reborn City's development in the past even aside from that,
Having been responsible for tracking down and shutting up some of Reborn City's most environmentally-damaging facilities.
Those who've seen her in action know that her star player, a Lapras named Deliverance,
Should only be underestimated by those who want to themselves be dragged under.
And how does a Pokémon get a name like that, you may wonder.
From what Miss Amaria has said in the past, it seems like it earned its name firsthand.
She tells a story about a time when she was swimming far out from the coast, only to be caught in the middle of a storm!
Make no mistake-- Amy is a stunning swimmer, but stormy seas can sink even the most stout ships.
So it was when Amaria thought she'd drawn her last breath that she found herself pulled first to the surface and second to safety by a Pokémon!
That Pokémon would be her lifelong companion, who she named Deliverance in thanks for it saving her life.
Turns out, Deliverance saves more than just lives though, with many of Amaria's past challengers having been staring it down as the face of defeat,
In what otherwise seemed like a won match for them.
As Amaria announces-- Deliverance always pulls through for her!
We've got a special program rolling out for you today on the Rock-type and rockin' roller renegade, Hardy Andersen!
If that last name sounds familiar to you, it should-- He's the younger brother of Steel Leader Titania Andersen...
And in a sense, he's got her to thank for his stairway to heaven!
You see, nowadays there isn't a whole lotta love between them, but they weren't always in such bad company.
Back in the glory days, the two of them were thick as thieves, united in their interest for Rock-type Pokémon!
But when Steel-types were discovered and were all the latest pride and joy of the Pokémon world, Titania jumped ship and went her own way!
She never looked back, but Hardy was determined to dream on with his classic type!
And thus started an enduring rivalry between the siblings-- one that don't stop even today!
Hardy's held that determination fast to take care of business and rise up in the ranks, raring to prove once and for all just which is the better type!
And indeed, Hardy isn't just another brick in the cabal of Rock Leaders at the bottom of their totems.
As the second highest-ranked Leader in Reborn, that boy promises to rock all his challengers like a hurricane!
Challengers looking to face down Hardy should take extra care for his Dusk Form Lycanroc!
This beast of burden promises to send any challenger free-fallin' unless they escape just by the hair of the dog!
And that's more than just a feeling.
On the chopping block today is the top-brass battler, gold medalist among the masters, Saphira Belrose!
This Dragon Type dame is a destructive force not to be fought lightly, as she vouchsafes her type's reputation as the kings of old!
And speaking of reputations, it'd seem that one runs in the family.
Saphira inherits her gym and power in two-step from her father, Montague Belrose, of the previous generation of Leaders.
Those who've remained in or returned to the region since old days might remember the fiery competition between he and Caroline Flambairn.
For those a little fresher to scene, so the story goes...
The two Leaders met after being stationed adjacent to each other between their cities.
True to her type, little Caroline was as hot-headed as they come, and from the outset she resented any competition from her neighbor!
After a spell of trying to outdo Monty in performance alone, she tried to prove herself by challenging him directly!
But chalk it up to a difference in rank, the type chart, or whatever you like...
No dice!
In a total sweep, Caroline hit the floor.
But the blazing broad up and tried again,
And again,
And again...
Months went by, and the sight of little Caroline fuming away from Monty's Gym was practically a daily ritual.
As all good stories must, though, this came to an end when she finally scored a win, proving her hard- earned strength once and for all!
The victory was a blessing to the regulars, tired of hearing howls of anger and annoyance each day when the Fire Type femme flew off the scene.
...So, you can imagine their shock and disappointment when, the next day after winning, Caroline once again showed up on Monty's doorstep anyway!
No one is quite sure what happened in the gym that day in particular, but rumor has it the two were quite inseparable after that!
And that blustering legacy lives on even now with their children having taken over their positions!
As for Saphira, the modern challenger may want to take one note of this legacy.
Her arena was rebuilt in the recent reconstruction of Labradorra City, but one hold-over from her father remains:
A certain game old Montague is said to have been quite fond of,
That he would make all his challengers play before fighting him.
Challengers, come stocked on potions and ready to fight to claim the title of king of the hill!
The unprepared may yet regret it.
When fighting Saphira herself, watch out for her famous Dragonite!
This multiscaled menace has hampered more than a few matches in its primetime, using its diamond defense out the door to set up a sweep!
I'll give you a hint, Trainers!
In her arena, there's only one type it's truly weak to...
Get in there and get ready to rock its world!
That's all for now, but remember, Trainers,
Keep fighting with everything you've got!
Hold your spirits high, and even you can defeat the Reborn League!
And now, a public service announcement:
Crime and pollution are at an all-time high in Reborn City.
But it doesn't have to be that way.
Do your part! Pick up where you can, and never litter!
Together we can keep Reborn's streets and waters clean.
For a better Reborn.
Need Potions?
Poké Balls?
Vitamins, Repels, Antidotes?
Berries, TMs, Awakenings, Battle Items, Freeze Heals, Burn Heals, Full Heals,
Every kind of heal you could possibly imagine!
Evolution stones, evolution items, items for luck, items for unluck, items for having too many damn items!
You need it?
We got it.
You don't need it?
We got that too.
The Obsidia Department Store,
Located in Central Obsidia at 11th and Saffron, sponsored by Silph Co.!
Going out soon? Or do you need to drop off your friend for some playtime?
Come to the Obsidia Day Care on Goldenrod Street, now back in business!
We'll take care of your Pokémon just like you would.
The Obsidia Day Care is now open!
Give us your Pokémon!
We will make them stronger than you could ever imagine!
We have no cap on the number of Pokémon we can raise for you!
So be sure and turn them all in to raise yourself a proper army!
You can be the strongest Trainer if you just come here!
The Obsidia Day Care, located in Central Obsidia at Goldenrod and 9th.
How are you doing today? And how's your Pokémon?
If your day is anything less than perfect, come by the Central Obsidia Salon!
Our first class services are provided by the top Pokémon breeders and caretakers in the world!
A quick stay here is guaranteed to make you smile, and never fails to bring you and your Pokémon closer!
Check us out! Central Obsidia Salon, located on Main Street in the Obsidia Ward.
Trainers! Looking for a challenge?
Think you have what it takes to rise to the top?!
The Reborn League is now accepting challengers!
Pit your Pokémon against our legion of 18 typed Gym Leaders-- the best in the business.
For the best of the best, 18 Badges earns you the right to challenge the famous Elite Four, and then the mysterious Champion!
Don't be shy!
Stop by the Grand Hall in the Opal Ward today!
Check out the Reborn Nightclub~
Want some wild nights? Hot action?
We're talking raves! Dancing, battles, music, this is the night life!
Check us out in the North Obsidia Ward, on Castelia Street near the Grand Stairway!
Ride in style!
Check out the Lapis Luxury Cycle Shop!
We have better bikes than anyone else in the world!
For the top, perfection knows no pricetag!
Check us out in the Lapis Ward at Peony and 4th!
Looking to become a top Trainer in Reborn?
The Onyx Trainers' School has what YOU need.
We cater to students of all skill levels.
Headed by one of Reborn's own Gym Leaders, the Onyx Trainers' School promises a learning experience you'll never forget!
The Onyx Trainers' School is a franchise of the Pokémon Technical Institute.
The Pokémon Technical Institute is pleased to offer its services to Reborn.
Enroll today in the Onyx Ward at 11th and Ivyline Road.
The Reborn Silph Co. Branch is now open.
Silph Co. is one of the oldest corporate names in the world.
Now we're here to offer you our finest services.
Silph Co.-- A name you can trust.
Need a treat?
Aching for sweets?
We've got the thing to beat the other eats!
The Sweet Kiss Candy Shop is now open!
We've got everything from Common Candy to Rare Candy-- and a whole host of delicious non-black licorice candy for both you AND your Pokémon!
We know you have a sweet tooth, and you should, as our products rival even major medicines in their effects!
Check out our upcoming competitions too, for a chance to win a rare Pokémon!
Remember, there's no need to be confused-- Sweet Kiss is your one-stop candy shop.
Come in today, to 10th and Main Street!
Need a break from studying?
From work?
Want the coolest place to hang out with the hottest games?
Check out the Onyx Arcade on 11th and Easterling!
We've got great games and fabulous prizes for both the hardcore and the casual!
Ready, set... Game on!
Are you tired of the bleak grey and black grimy get- up of the city spectacle?
Come visit Sweet Scent!
Reborn's very own flower shop, located in the Lapis Ward at 3rd and Hydrangea Street!
We guarantee the perfect floral flourish for any apartment or home.
Check us out, and you won't be disappointed!
RINGMASTER: Hello, hello, boys, girls, ladies, gentlemen, and everything in between!
Agate Circus is open for business under a new owner, and boy, do we have a show for you!
We have the greatest show in all of Reborn featuring a host of zany clowns, the strongest man you'll ever meet, and the alluring charm of an aerial ballet!
We have games!
Candy!
Pokémon!
Our main show now includes 500% more Donphan!
No, seriously, we have so many Donphan here that it's stupid!
So come on and do something! Anything! At the Agate Circus!
CRITICAL CAPTURE!
Located on 9th and Main Street in the Central Obsidia Ward, Critical Capture has a unique variety of Poké Balls to suit any Trainer's needs.
Come on by and catch a great deal!
Helllllo there, Reborn City.
We know that times have been tough.
And in these tough times, sometimes it's hard to find a minute-- or a place-- to sit down, relax, and have a cold drink.
Why don't you come on down to the Spyce?
Featuring good eats, smooth music, and the best beer in town,
The Spyce has it all.
Find us on 9th Street by Castelia. Come on in, and Spyce up your life.
Need to spice up your roster?
Looking for new Pokémon?
Welcome to Reborn's Pokémon Watch!
Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Peridot and Opal Wards! What is there to find?
Well, rumour has it that sometimes a cheery blue Pokémon can be seen dancing around the fountain in North Peridot when it rains.
Today, we're looking at the small reserve of wildlife around the Grand Hall.
Only a few species can be found here, however.
Oh, my, is that a Combee?
Where could it have come from?
There certainly aren't any in the grass around here.
How curious!
This morning, we visited a secret garden.
The owner of the garden wishes to keep himself and its location anonymous, but there were some neat Pokémon!
In fact, we even saw a group of Cherubi! Fascinating how such things live right under our noses..
Unfortunately, the Cherubi had made themselves scarce by afternoon.
Perhaps they like the morning cool?
Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the South Obsidia, Coral and Onyx Wards!
Rumour has it that deep in the Obsidia Slums, there's a secret room where a certain species of beefy Pokémon hang out!
Normally on this show, we only talk about wild Pokémon, but I just saw this energetic Lillipup, and can't help but talk about it!
The feisty thing was dragging its poor Trainer all over the city!
By the West Peridot Factory...
...to under Opal Bridge...
...back up to North Peridot...
...or in the back of the Obsidia Ward...
...even down to the Coral Ward!
Finally, they ended up in the Onyx Ward!
There's no telling where that pup will go!
Today, we were passing through the Coral Ward, down around the warehouses, and there was this awful banging.
It almost sounded like a Pokémon was trapped inside.
But I wonder what it could be?
Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the Jasper and Beryl Wards!
Actually, earlier today we came across a police officer who was looking for a certain Pokémon and had a rare Egg to offer in return!
I smell an opportunity for one generous and lucky Trainer!
In fact, just last night we passed through the Beryl Cemetery.
It was a terrifying experience!
I was afraid that a zombie would rise up and attack me!
And to my fright, something did!
Well, our cameraman turned tail and fled before we could catch the culprit on film, so as of yet, it is unidentified.
But for all you brave Trainers out there, be warned that there could be something lurking...
Ah, wait, what's this over here?!
It's an Aipom! What a cutie!
Oh, hey, no, don't run away! Come back!
Ah, it scampered back up into that tree.
No matter, we still know that there are Aipom in this area now! What a rare find!
Today, we're looking for Pokémon in the North Obsidia and Lapis Wards!
We're chasing rumors of a rare Pokémon digging around behind the streets of Obsidia!
This howling black beast is said to be extremely elusive, but!
We've been tracking it, and we think we've found--
???: 'Ey, you trespassin' on our territory?
HOST: Oh, um, hi, what? No, sir! We're just innocent news--
???: Get outta here! Or I'll make you get out!
HOST: Okay!
Following rumors of a rare Pokémon having been seen in the area, we've tracked it down to this location: A lavish house in the Lapis Ward.
Let's find out if we can meet the owner of this rare Po--
CRAUDBURRY: What's all that racket out there?!
HOST: Ah, hello! Are you the owner of--
CRAUDBURRY: I don't need your scandalous press loitering around my house!
This is MY property, and I can have you arrested for filming without consent!
HOST: Miss, please calm down--
CRAUDBURRY: What's your network? I'll sue!
Stand right there, I'm getting my lawyer!
HOST: Yikes, and after everything we couldn't find any Pokémon. Bye!
You will not BELIEVE what we've just seen!
A legendary Pokémon, right here in Reborn!
Before our eyes, a beautiful Mew jumped right by and vanished!
We're on the hunt now! We know it ran this way, and-- Oh my word!
That's a Victini! Two legends in one day?!
What is this?!
Quick, follow it!
Aw, where did it go?
Wait, back there! It's a--
Darkrai?!
Wait, it just transformed into... Oh!
It's a Zorua!
But it ran off...
Trainers, keep an eye out for this illusive catch!
It could take the shape of anything!
Today, we're looking for Pokémon all over Reborn City!
Following a beaten path off from the Beryl Cemetery, we come through a dark cave to a place somewhere deep in the Rhodochrine Jungle...
What kind of mysterious Pokémon will we-- Aah!!!
What? We seem to have been trapped in some sort of cage!
What Pokémon could have done this?!
We've got a special report coming in!
Sean Slagle from the Peridot Ward writes to us about a strange Pokémon that appears only when it rains!
You might expect that this would be a Water-type!
But no! It's actually, of all things, a Numel!
Sean tells us that the poor Pokémon wanders out in every storm looking lost and confused.
It’s obviously suffering from the rain, but the strange thing can't figure out what to do with itself!
Today we were checking out the alleys of the city when we found a certain pool.
Two surprises awaited us-- the first being that the water in this place was miraculously not contaminated.
The second being that it was teeming with dangerous Pokémon?
Which?
We'll let our viewers find out themselves!
Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Apophyll Beach and Pyrous Mountain!
We're exploring a cave far out across the beach.
There's no telling what could be inside!
Hey, what's that!
Moving there in the shadows!
What kind of Pokémon could it be!?
It's a--
Oh, it's just a Stunfisk.
That's not exciting.
Cut, cut. We'll have to look somewhere else...
Just today we were walking down the beach, when suddenly one of the volcanic stones started shaking!
Anxious to uncover the source of this tremor, we smashed open the rock in a hurry.
Inside was a unique Pokémon!
It's Shuckle!
How strange!
But it didn't seem like there would be very many.  Could this be a rare find?!
We've been tracking a mysterious Pokémon in the depths of Pyrous Mountain!
This lava-loving creature is elusive and lonesome, but after dedicated research, I think we've finally found its habits.
And they're quite silly!
It seems this Pokémon loves to eat molten stone and other minerals... but with the volatile lava flow in Pyrous Mountain, sometimes falls right into it!
Thus, we wound up finding this Pokémon stuck in some other cooling magma!
It seems this Pokémon crawls off to brood on its own in a far off, but very heated place!
We weren't able to get our attention ourselves...
But a clever Trainer could perhaps lure it to a catch!
Today, we're looking for Pokémon around Azurine Island and the Byxbysion Wasteland!
However, horror has struck us in the Wasteland!
After being bafflingly lost inside the hallowed halls and walls of the mountainous tundra...
An apparition has revealed itself to us!
Needless to say, we high-tailed it out of there, but a braver Trainer may find a prize for themselves if they dare face it!
This morning, we were traveling through Azurine Island, and one of our cameramen leaned on a nearby tree.
Imagine his surprise when a spirited Psychic-type fell out of it, right on top of his head!
They were NOT happy!
Today, we were relaxing in the Wasteland-- if one can 'relax' in such a chaotic place-- when we chanced upon an adorable duo.
Two young Nidoran were playing in the Wasteland's tunnels!
Not ideal scenery, but the young Pokémon were a picture-perfect pair.
Too bad they scampered off, but there seem to be Nidoran out there waiting for a Trainer to find!
Today, we're searching the Chrysolia Region for new Pokémon!
This morning, we found a hidden clearing in the middle of the Chrysolia Forest!
Although we didn't find any Pokémon, we did find another little gem that could be useful to Trainers: A rock positively glowing with moss!
Who might find this useful, hm?
Could such a Pokémon be nearby?
We've unveiled quite the mystery!
Late last night, our group stumbled upon a cave.
The inside of the cave was very confusing, winding in circles, almost like a riddle-- but never mind that!
Let's talk about the rare Pokémon inside!
By some luck, we encountered a Smeargle!
With its Sketch attack, it could be an invaluable tool for any breeder that can get their hands on it.
This evening, we're searching the shore of a surprisingly pure lake in the Chrysolia Region!
With all the pollution around the city, it's a marvel that a place like this could exist!
Even more marvelous, tons of Pokémon flock to its shore, and many cute ones!
But one cutie especially caught our eye: A little Poliwag wagging its way along the lake!
Maybe some Trainer might like to add this doll to their collection!
Today, we're looking in the vast Aventurine Region of Reborn!
Oh! Look at that! It's a Heracross!
